title: Carlos Marigil Alba
text:
With a passion for mobility planning, and several years in the practice, I am conducting PhD project at Universidad Complutense de Madrid. My research focuses on spatial interaction models, territorial accessibility and urban development in the Madrid metropolitan area, with a strong focus in the future of this territory. My thesis develops a framework to forecast transport futures with innovative datasets, GIS and R.
I create periferias as a little research repository —a space for analytical notes, methodological reflections, maps, and occasional field writing.

title: Carlos Marigil Alba
section: Raised in Alcalá de Henares, my life has brought me in the last 10 years to live in Paris, Barcelona and Madrid, and several short experiences in Lyon, Toronto and London. With a deep passion for public transport and cities, I have an educational background in Architecture (Universidad de Alcalá), Urban and transport planning (Ecole d’urbanisme de Paris, Ecole de Ponts) and Geography (UCM). Also integrated in Ingerop, where I learn and grow as a planner with great professionals since 7 years now, and grateful to its research department support. A strong believer in intersectional research between fields, practice and academy. A passionate musician and a languages enthousiast ;)
